operators.note: Check cheapest predicate (shipmode dict code) first to skip ~71% of rows before date comparisons. Use receiptdate zone map (lineitem_receiptdate_zm) to skip entire blocks outside [8766,9131).
O(1) dense array lookup. orders_pk_index maps orderkey to row_id; then read o_orderpriority[row_id]. Every lineitem orderkey has a matching order (FK constraint), so no row loss.

aggregates.name: high_line_count
aggregates.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

aggregates.name: low_line_count
aggregates.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN o_orderpriority NOT IN (1, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
aggregates.note: dict codes NOT in {1,3} means 5-LOW, 4-NOT SPECIFIED, 3-MEDIUM

operators.implementation_hint: int64 accums[2][2] — indexed by [shipmode_slot][high_or_low]. Thread-local arrays, merge at end. No hash table needed.

operators.note: Trivial sort of 2 rows. Emit MAIL before SHIP (alphabetical). Decode l_shipmode dict codes back to strings for output.

data_structures.lineitem_filter: branchless_predicate_chain with dict_code bitset[7] for shipmode
data_structures.priority_check: bitset[5] with bits 1,3 set for high-priority codes

parallelism.note: Parallel scan of lineitem with thread-local aggregation arrays. Merge is trivial: sum 2x2 arrays across threads.

indexes.note: Skip lineitem blocks where max(l_receiptdate) < 8766 or min(l_receiptdate) >= 9131
Dense array: orderkey -> row_id for O(1) access to o_orderpriority
